references.text: This month shall be for you the beginning of months; it shall be the first month of the year. This establishes the first month in the Israelite calendar.
Today you are going out, in the month of Abib. Reference to the first month when Israel left Egypt.
God's command to build a sanctuary (mishkan) where he may dwell among his people. This is the original instruction for the tabernacle.
Detailed instructions for building the tabernacle (mishkan) and the tent of meeting (ohel moed).
Reference to the tent of meeting (ohel moed) where Aaron and his sons shall tend the lamps before the Lord's presence.
Moses took the tent and set it up outside the camp. He called it the tent of meeting (ohel moed).
All the work on the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, was completed. The Israelites did everything just as the Lord had commanded Moses.
Fulfillment of the command: In the second year, on the first day of the first month, the tabernacle was erected.
The day Moses finished setting up the tabernacle, he anointed it and consecrated it.
On the day the tabernacle was set up, the cloud covered the tabernacle over the tent of the testimony.
Description of the first tent (the tabernacle) with its furnishings, which points back to the tent of meeting in the Old Testament.
The theological principle of following the 'pattern' (26:30) is made concrete in the historical action on the appointed day (40:2).
